Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This study is not a perturbation or differential proteomics experiment. It is a quality control (QC) and machine learning study aimed at predicting the success of chemical peptide synthesis based on amino acid sequence. The mass spectrometry was used as a readout for synthesis success (successful vs. failed), but there was no biological treatment or perturbation applied to a biological system. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
